note: unseen-anim-cap: docs/144 §3.5 [UnseenAnim] CapPasses=4 (cap = max(MaxOwedMs, 4 x pass dt), HardCapMs 1500), NOT RUN. Build both commits of feature/unseen-table, copy out-*/ts3native.asi to game-copy/ts3native.asi.unseentable1 and the ts3fixes package to game-copy/ts3fixes.package.unseentable1. Order: smoke (auto), bp-uac-snapback (correctness, owed pose time run on seen again), bp-uac-stuck-on (stuck Sims vs bp-ua-stuck-off of unseen-anim-ab, same ini otherwise), then the 4 in-load A/Bs (--ab unseenanim, CapPasses=4 in both arms). Pass/verdict: aaSkipped >> 50/s and aaHold_5 falls in on slices (I-418-2), aaDebtMaxUs <= 1,500,000, no crash, no frozen pose; gain = aaUs_1 and aaPassUs off minus on, sim ms/s, hitch-ab.ts counts. Stop rule: aaSkipped still < 500/s in the smoke = the cap is not the blocker, stop and triage. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/unseen-anim-cap.json
